job.title: Legal assistant - banking & finance
job.description:
Our client is a leading real estate and finance group seeking to recruit a banking & finance legal and admin assistant to join its high performing team in Melbourne.
  
You will provide support on the full-suite of documentation and processes involved in the settlement of property loans / mortgages. This is a highly-business facing position and you'll work closely with different departments internally and also external stakeholders such as banks, and solicitors for counterparties.
  
You will work on matters for their full life cycle, from approval through to settlement and then funding. You'll be an experienced finance / settlements assistant with strong knowledge of mortgage / property loan documentation and ideally the PEXA settlement process.
  
This position is offered on a full-time basis, and requires an on-site presence in the office 5 days per week to work closely with the business and other members of the legal team.

job.title: Legal counsel - commercial - FMCG
job.description:
Global FMCG (food & beverage) company is seeking a commercial legal counsel to work with the Head of Legal for ANZ, based in Melbourne.
You'll be excited to work in this dynamic and collaborative organisation and team, specialising in negotiating a range of commercial contacts but also advising on ESG and sustainability initiatives and other projects as required. This is a very broad in-house position where you'll have great exposure to all legal matters affecting the business and be able to take ownership of particular areas of interest.
Some limited overseas travel is involved in the position and you'll have the ability to work within a stellar group of lawyers across the APAC region in this position.
Experience in the FMCG, food, retail and/or agricultural industries is helpful but not essential for this position.

job.title: Litigation lawyer - in-house
job.description:
Kelly Gordine are pleased to partner with this family office / law firm in their search for an additional litigation lawyer to work on a wide range of contentious matters across the group's businesses in this quasi in-house position.
In this highly unique position, you will be employed by the group's law firm but enjoy unparalleled work-life balance and no billable hours targets - this is because you will work on a very broad range of commercial litigation matters, for a variety of businesses owned by the family office, spanning everything from manufacturing, healthcare, education, professional services and other companies.
The work will include everything from complex Supreme Court matters to general commercial disputes, insolvency, enforcement and recovery matters. While external counsel (from top law firms) are still engaged for specialised areas of law, you'll be expected to be able to run with litigation and be confident and credible in this position involving working directly with key stakeholders across the various businesses.
You will have excellent drafting and advocacy skills, hold a current NSW practicing certificate and be excited to work in this unique and highly rewarding position where you can enjoy the breadth of an incredible practice but also your life outside of the office.

job.title: Banking & Finance Lawyer - In-House
job.description:
Leading financial services company requires Senior Legal Counsel to join expanding legal team.
  
This is a newly created role to work with another senior counsel in a highly collaborative team covering a range of banking & finance deals including project finance, asset finance, mining and commodities finance, derivatives and structured finance.
  
You will work closely as a business partner and must be able to transact with limited supervision and build excellent working relationships with senior stakeholders both internally and externally. You will therefore have a minimum of 10 years’ PQE and have experience practicing as a banking lawyer at a top-tier or mid-tier law firm, or reputable banking institution in Australia.
  
This position is based in Sydney's CBD and is offered on a full-time hybrid working basis with 3 days in the office.
  
You’ll be one a team of stellar lawyers within a highly reputable organisation that offers an excellent working environment and above-market benefits.
